youtube_description:
The Jet Market Shakeup (2006–2026)

Watch 20 years of market-cap drama: Boeing's rise and catastrophic stumble (737 MAX groundings in 2019 + the COVID collapse in 2020), Airbus's rebound and backlog-fueled surge, Lockheed's defense-driven climb, and Embraer's niche volatility. This chart race uses year-end market caps (Billions USD) to tell how safety crises, pandemics, and defense budgets reshaped aerospace fortunes.

If you liked this visualization, subscribe for more high-contrast chart-race videos and hit the bell — new data stories every week. Drop a comment: which company surprised you the most?

Sources: company year-end market capitalizations and public filings, combined with major public events (737 MAX groundings, COVID-19 airline collapse, global defense spending trends).
